title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: From the silent upper floors of Addlestone to the sun-drenched alcoves of the Rita Hollings Science Center, these ten spots offer the best environments for focused work on campus.

cards.title: Third Floor Silent Zone
cards.subtitle: Addlestone Library
cards.notes: Head to the third floor for strictly silent study; even earbuds must be kept at low volume to maintain the quiet atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: The designated silent study floor of the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2nd and 3rd floors of Addlestone Library are reserved for silent study and listening only through earbuds.
cards.source_title: Q. Where can I study in Addlestone Library? - Ask Us!
cards.access_notes: Open to students with Cougar Card; check library site for seasonal hours.

cards.title: Science Center Window Alcoves
cards.subtitle: Rita Hollings Science Center
cards.notes: Utilize the built-in whiteboards and natural light in the hallway alcoves for collaborative STEM problem-solving sessions.
cards.short_summary: Modern study alcoves with whiteboards and floor-to-ceiling windows.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rita Liddy Hollings Science Center features dynamic seating options, ample windows, and whiteboards on every floor.
cards.source_title: Lovely Rita Liddy Hollings Science Center - The College Today
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible during academic building hours.

cards.title: Rivers Green Tables
cards.subtitle: Behind Addlestone Library
cards.notes: Grab a patio table behind the library for an outdoor session with easy access to the nearby Starbucks for caffeine breaks.
cards.short_summary: A popular outdoor green space with tables and Wi-Fi connectivity.
cards.evidence_claim: Rivers Green is a preferred outdoor study spot with plenty of tables and patio furniture located behind the library.
cards.source_title: Favorite Study Locations at CofC – The Honor Roll
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; well-lit at night with campus security nearby.

cards.title: Stern Center Upper Lounges
cards.subtitle: Stern Student Center
cards.notes: Visit the second, third, or fourth floors for quieter lounge seating away from the high-traffic first-floor game room.
cards.short_summary: Multi-level student center offering various lounge and table setups.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stern Center has computers on the first floor and study spaces on the second, third, and fourth floors.
cards.source_title: Stern Student Center - College of Charleston
cards.access_notes: Requires Cougar Card for entry after hours; check for finals week extensions.

cards.title: Beatty Center Atrium
cards.subtitle: School of Business
cards.notes: Study in the light-filled atrium of the business school, which offers a professional atmosphere and ample seating.
cards.short_summary: A high-ceilinged atrium in the School of Business with natural light.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beatty Center Atrium is cited as a fan-favorite study location for business majors and others.
cards.source_title: School of Business Facilities - College of Charleston
cards.access_notes: Open during standard academic building hours.

cards.title: Education Center 24/7 Lounge
cards.subtitle: Education Center
cards.notes: Access this building 24/7 for late-night sessions; it is a reliable alternative when the library closes.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour accessible academic building with dedicated study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Education Center is noted for being open 24/7 for student study needs.
cards.source_title: Favorite Study Locations at CofC – The Honor Roll
cards.access_notes: 24/7 access typically requires a valid Cougar Card for entry.

cards.title: Harbor Walk Waterfront Seating
cards.subtitle: Computer Science Department
cards.notes: Enjoy views of the Cooper River and Ravenel Bridge while studying on the outdoor balconies of this waterfront complex.
cards.short_summary: Waterfront study areas located at the Aquarium Wharf campus extension.
cards.evidence_claim: Harbor Walk features a balcony overlooking the Cooper River and provides a quiet place for schoolwork.
cards.source_title: My Space: Harbor Walk, Room 319 - The College Today
cards.access_notes: Located about a mile from main campus; accessible via CARTA bus or bike.

cards.title: Hillel Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Jewish Studies Center
cards.notes: Relax in the comfy study areas of the Hillel Lounge; don't miss Bagel Tuesday for a mid-study snack.
cards.short_summary: A cozy student lounge with a home-like atmosphere for focused work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jewish Studies Center houses comfy study areas and the Hillel Student Lounge for student use.
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; check for specific Hillel event schedules.

cards.title: Collaborative Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Addlestone Library
cards.notes: Reserve a room online for groups of 3+; these spaces include whiteboards and are ideal for group projects.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group study rooms equipped with whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: Collaborative Study Rooms may be reserved for groups of 3 or more persons for up to two hours per day.
cards.source_title: Q. Where can I study in Addlestone Library? - Ask Us!
cards.access_notes: Reservations required via LibCal; Cougar Card needed for check-in.

cards.title: Phillis Wheatley Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Avery Research Center
cards.notes: Book an appointment for a highly focused, scholarly environment surrounded by African American history and culture.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, appointment-only reading room for specialized research.
cards.evidence_claim: The Phillis Wheatley Literary and Social Club Reading Room is open by appointment for on-site research.
cards.access_notes: Appointment required at least two business days in advance.
